arxiv-2101-08512.description: Abstract We present extensive, well-sampled optical and ultraviolet photometry and optical spectra of the Type Ia supernova (SN Ia) 2017hpa. arxiv-2204-04028.title: A Generic Image Retrieval Method for Date Estimation of Historical Document Collections
arxiv-2204-04028.creator: Adrià Molina, Lluis Gomez, Oriol Ramos Terrades, Josep Lladós
arxiv-2204-04028.description: Abstract Date estimation of historical document images is a challenging problem, with several contributions in the literature that lack of the ability to generalize from one dataset to others. This paper presents a robust date estimation system based in a retrieval approach that generalizes well in front of heterogeneous collections.

arxiv-2210-17315.title: Real-Time Calibration of Disaggregated Traffic Demand
arxiv-2210-17315.creator: Mozhgan Pourmoradnasseri, Kaveh Khoshkhah, Amnir Hadachi
arxiv-2210-17315.description: Abstract Real-time traffic demand estimation is essential for intelligent transportation systems and traffic forecasting in urban areas. Hence, this paper presents a simulation-based optimization framework for city-scale real-time estimation and calibration of dynamic demand models by focusing on disaggregated microsimulation in congested networks.

arxiv-2211-02464.title: AGN sub-populations important for black hole mass growth: a rule of thumb
arxiv-2211-02464.creator: Johannes Buchner
arxiv-2211-02464.description: Abstract For building the super-massive black hole population within a Hubble time, only sub-populations with more than 10 52 ​ erg / s / L ¯ 10^{52}\mathrm{erg/s}/\overline{L} objects on the sky are relevant, where L ¯ \overline{L} is the sample-averaged bolometric luminosity.

arxiv-2302-04276.creator: Kevin Wolz, Susanna Azzoni, Carlos Hervías-Caimapo, Josquin Errard, Nicoletta Krachmalnicoff, David Alonso, Carlo Baccigalupi, Antón Baleato Lizancos, Michael L. arxiv-2303-04426.title: NASTyLinker: NIL-Aware Scalable Transformer-based Entity Linker
arxiv-2303-04426.creator: Nicolas Heist, Heiko Paulheim
arxiv-2303-04426.description: Abstract Entity Linking (EL) is the task of detecting mentions of entities in text and disambiguating them to a reference knowledge base. Most prevalent EL approaches assume that the reference knowledge base is complete. In practice, however, it is necessary to deal with the case of linking to an entity that is not contained in the knowledge base (NIL entity).

arxiv-2308-11290.title: ShadowNet for Data-Centric Quantum System Learning
arxiv-2308-11290.creator: Yuxuan Du, Yibo Yang, Tongliang Liu, Zhouchen Lin, Bernard Ghanem, Dacheng Tao
arxiv-2308-11290.description: Abstract Understanding the dynamics of large quantum systems is hindered by the curse of dimensionality. Statistical learning offers new possibilities in this regime by neural-network protocols and classical shadows, while both methods have limitations: the former is plagued by the predictive uncertainty and the latter lacks the generalization ability.

arxiv-2309-01180.title: A Usage-Aware Sequent Calculus for Differential Dynamic Logic CCS: Theory of computation Logic and verification CCS: Theory of computation Program analysis CCS: Software and its engineering Error handling and recovery
arxiv-2309-01180.creator: Myra Dotzel, Stefan Mitsch, André Platzer
arxiv-2309-01180.description: Abstract . Ensuring that safety-critical applications behave as intended is an important yet challenging task. Modeling languages like differential dynamic logic ( dL ) have proof calculi capable of proving guarantees for such applications. However, dL programmers may unintentionally over-specify assumptions and program statements, which results in overly constrained models that yield weak or vacuous guarantees.

arxiv-2309-16830.title: Robust Safe Control with Multi-Modal Uncertainty
arxiv-2309-16830.creator: Tianhao Wei, Liqian Ma, Ravi Pandya, Changliu Liu
arxiv-2309-16830.description: Abstract Safety in dynamic systems with prevalent uncertainties is crucial. Current robust safe controllers, designed primarily for uni-modal uncertainties, may be either overly conservative or unsafe when handling multi-modal uncertainties. To address the problem, we introduce a novel framework for robust safe control, tailored to accommodate multi-modal Gaussian dynamics uncertainties and control limits.

arxiv-2410-15166.title: Adversarial Estimation of Binary Configuration Probabilities under Sparse Dependence
arxiv-2410-15166.description: Abstract We consider the problem of estimating probabilities of binary configurations, which is common in operations management applications, including product bundling, advertising, etc. Existing approaches typically model each binary component as a category and apply multinomial models to estimate the choice probabilities.

arxiv-2502-01664.title: New General Fixed-Point Approach to Compute the Resolvent of Composite Operators
arxiv-2502-01664.creator: Samir Adly, Ba Khiet Le
arxiv-2502-01664.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a new general and stable fixed-point approach to compute the resolvents of the composition of a set-valued maximal monotone operator with a linear bounded mapping. Weak, strong and linear convergence of the proposed algorithms are obtained. Advantages of our method over the existing approaches are also thoroughly analyzed. Keywords.

arxiv-2510-11246.title: Collaborative Shadows: Distributed Backdoor Attacks in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
arxiv-2510-11246.creator: Pengyu Zhu, Lijun Li, Yaxing Lyu, Li Sun, Sen Su, Jing Shao
arxiv-2510-11246.description: Abstract LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) demonstrate increasing integration into next-generation applications, but their safety in backdoor attacks remains largely underexplored. However, existing research has focused exclusively on single-agent backdoor attacks, overlooking the novel attack surfaces introduced by agent collaboration in MAS. To bridge this gap, we present the first Distributed Backdoor Attack tailored to MAS.

arxiv-2601-19618.title: The pretraining domain outweighs the training objective in setting the privacy-utility trade-off of differentially private medical image analysis
arxiv-2601-19618.creator: Soroosh Tayebi Arasteh ∗, Mina Farajiamiri, Mahshad Lotfinia, Behrus Hinrichs-Puladi, Jonas Bienzeisler, Mohamed Alhaskir, Mirabela Rusu, Christiane Kuhl, Sven Nebelung, Daniel Truhn
arxiv-2601-19618.description: Abstract Differential privacy limits how much each training image can influence a medical imaging model but lowers its diagnostic accuracy. Pretrained weights reduce this loss. It is unknown whether the pretraining objective or domain improves accuracy more. Here we train chest radiograph classifiers under differential privacy from five starting points on 591,884 radiographs from five datasets.

pmc-11359428.title: Plasma EV-miRNAs as Potential Biomarkers of COVID-19 Vaccine Immune Response in Cancer Patients
pmc-11359428.creator: Beatriz Almeida, Tânia R. Dias, Pedro Cruz, Mário Sousa-Pimenta, Ana Luísa Teixeira, Catarina Esteves Pereira, Bruno Costa-Silva, Júlio Oliveira, Rui Medeiros, Francisca Dias
pmc-11359428.description: Cancer patients, prone to severe COVID-19, face immune challenges due to their disease and treatments. Identifying biomarkers, particularly extracellular vesicle (EV)-derived microRNAs (miRNAs), is vital for comprehending their response to COVID-19 vaccination. Therefore, this study aimed to investigate specific EV-miRNAs in the plasma of cancer patients under active treatment who received the COVID-19 booster vaccine.

pmc-11516948.title: Strengthening youth mental health capacities in Albania: Training primary healthcare professionals
pmc-11516948.creator: G Qirjako, A Qosja, R Çumashi, A Meksi, R Hala, L Zikaj, S Qirjako, E Tollozhina, A Pilika, E Tomini
pmc-11516948.description: BackgroundAddressing mental health issues among children and adolescents globally is crucial, necessitating interventions at the primary healthcare (PHC) level. The training programme in Albania equipped PHC professionals with skills for early identification, support, and referral for youth mental health issues.

pmc-11629994.title: The development of the Community Deprivation Index and its application to accountable care organizations
pmc-11629994.creator: John Robst, Ryan Cogburn, Grayson Forlines, Lex Frazier, John Kautter
pmc-11629994.description: There is strong interest among policymakers to adjust for area-level deprivation when making payments to providers because such areas have traditionally been underserved. The Medicare Accountable Care Organization Realizing Equity, Access, and Community Health (ACO REACH) model provides higher payments to ACOs serving areas with greater deprivation.

pmc-11692880.title: FRAMING AGE AND IMMIGRATION: OLDER IMMIGRANT WOMEN AND WELL-BEING IN A TIME OF SOCIAL INTOLERANCE
pmc-11692880.creator: Jasmin Tahmaseb
pmc-11692880.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). In today’s contemporary troubling social climate, discourse against immigration is on the rise. older immigrants make up 13 % of the older adult population. The media often portrays both older adults and immigrants in biased and stereotypical ways, such portrayal can have a negative impact on the well-being of older immigrants and increase late life isolation and loneliness.

pmc-12495233.title: Quantification of HER2-low and ultra-low expression in breast cancer specimens by quantitative IHC and artificial intelligence
pmc-12495233.creator: Frederik Aidt, Elad Arbel, Itay Remer, Oded Ben-David, Amir Ben-Dor, Daniela Rabkin, Kirsten Hoff, Karin Salomon, Sarit Aviel-Ronen, Gitte Nielsen, Jens Mollerup, Lars Jacobsen, Anya Tsalenko
pmc-12495233.description: Recent results of clinical trials in antibody drug conjugate (ADC) therapies have significantly broadened treatment options for the HER2 low and ultra-low breast cancer patients. However, sensitive, accurate and quantitative evaluation of HER2 expression based on current immunohistochemistry (IHC) assays remains challenging, especially in low and ultra-low HER2 expression ranges.

pmc-13320497.creator: Jonathan Mertens, Maarten Spinhoven, Rie Braspenning, Floris Vanhevel, Eveline Dirinck, Christophe De Block, Sven Francque
pmc-13320497.description: Background & AimsInsulin resistance is associated with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) in the general population, but its relationship with MASLD in individuals with type 1 diabetes (T1D) remains insufficiently defined.MethodsWe performed a 40 mU/m2/min hyperinsulinaemic-euglycaemic clamp to quantify the whole-body glucose disposal rate (M-value, mg/kg/min).

pmc-13601529.title: Regiospecific de mayo reactions of enamino ketones
pmc-13601529.creator: Wenle Zhu, Xin Sun, Dong Tian, Shanshan Cao, Xiaowei Zhao, Zhiyong Jiang
pmc-13601529.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The de Mayo reaction is a powerful photochemical method for skeletal editing, enabling rapid synthesis of 1,5-dicarbonyl compounds through formal addition of 1,3-dicarbonyl units across olefins. However, its regio- and chemoselectivity remain limited. Distinct aryl groups cannot be selectively installed on 1,5-diketones; substituents in 1-aryl-5-alkyl diketones favor the α-position of the aryl ketone; and electron-withdrawing groups from deficient olefins are generally restricted to the 3-position. Such olefins also favor radical addition and formal redox pathways over the desired reaction.
